note: The two sets are essentially identical in content: both capture the filter characteristics, all five control regions, the peak power coefficient with its wind-speed/pitch/tip-speed-ratio conditions, and the rated values (1173.7 rpm, 5 MW, 5.296610 MW, 43,093.55 N·m, 94.4%). Differences are only cosmetic (quote wording such as 'the rated mechanical power...' vs 'rated mechanical power...', entity labels like 'generator-slip' vs 'generator | slip percentage', and condition ordering). Both contain the same duplicated Region 3 torque claim and the same slightly indirect 'chosen filter flat in pass band' claim, so neither gains an advantage.
